snippet.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator | Lufthansa Liveries
snippet.description:
Coming soon! Two iconic franchises come together to celebrate aviation and 100 years of Lufthansa.

The Microsoft Flight Simulator team is delighted to announce the upcoming release of the current fleet of Lufthansa aircraft for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, a special project created to celebrate one of aviation's most iconic milestones: 100 years of Lufthansa.

Since its founding 100 years ago, Lufthansa has connected people, cultures, and continents, becoming one of the world's most recognized airlines and a symbol of excellence in commercial aviation.

To honor this remarkable journey, the upcoming livery package offers a selection of six meticulously recreated and authentic Lufthansa liveries allowing simmers to relive and celebrate Lufthansa's enduring legacy in the skies.

Whether you're a longtime Lufthansa enthusiast, a virtual airline pilot, or simply someone who appreciates aviation history, this collection of liveries offers a unique opportunity to experience a century of flight from the cockpit.

Join us to celebrate 100 years of Lufthansa and prepare to take aviation history to the skies once again in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The liveries are coming soon to MSFS 2024. The sky is calling!
